blocks.zh: 理解為何 IT 基礎設施需要正式的 SOP 框架，而不只是技術設定文件

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Standard Operating Procedure / 標準作業程序 (SOP): 正式書面化、經核准的程序文件，描述如何一致且可重複地執行特定作業。在 GMP 環境下，SOP 不只是「最佳做法建議」——它是法規稽核的直接檢視對象。
blocks.en: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): A formally documented, approved procedure describing how a specific task is performed consistently and repeatably. In a GMP environment an SOP is not just a "best practice recommendation"; it is a direct object of regulatory inspection.

blocks.zh: Quality Records / 品質記錄: 作業執行後產生的客觀證據。SOP 告訴你「怎麼做」，records 則證明「真的照著做了」。兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: Quality Records: Objective evidence generated after a task is performed. The SOP tells you "how to do it"; the records prove it was "actually done that way". You need both.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像 SOP 是餐廳的食譜手冊，quality records 則是每次出菜前的品管核對單。光有食譜不夠——每次出餐都需要留下記錄，才能在客訴時追溯責任。IT 基礎設施的 SOP 邏輯完全相同：稽核員來訪時，他們要看的不只是文件，更要看執行記錄。
blocks.en: Think of an SOP as a restaurant's recipe book and quality records as the quality check sheet completed before each dish leaves the kitchen. A recipe alone is not enough: every service needs a record so that responsibility can be traced when a customer complains. The logic for IT infrastructure SOPs is exactly the same: when an auditor visits, they want to see not only the documents but, above all, the execution records.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: 附錄強調文件選擇取決於公司規模、複雜度、地理分布、對關鍵面向的影響等因素。這意味著 SOP 不是「一套通用版本套用所有公司」——CDMO 必須根據自身的客戶多樣性、產品複雜度以及驗證狀態，客製化其 IT SOP 架構。
blocks.en: The appendix stresses that the choice of documents depends on factors such as company size, complexity, geographic distribution and impact on critical aspects. This means an SOP set is not "one universal version for every company": a CDMO must tailor its IT SOP architecture to its own client diversity, product complexity and validation status.

blocks.zh: Table A4.1: SOP Requirements Matrix — 完整需求矩陣
blocks.en: Table A4.1: SOP Requirements Matrix (Full Requirements Matrix)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：矩陣三欄結構
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Three-Column Matrix Structure

blocks.zh: Table A4.1 採用三欄格式，反映 GMP 文件管理的核心邏輯：
blocks.en: Table A4.1 uses a three-column format that reflects the core logic of GMP document management:

blocks.zh: 欄一 Area or Aspect（領域）：定義需要管控的功能區域（例如安全管理、資料備份）
blocks.en: Column 1, Area or Aspect: Defines the functional area to be controlled (e.g. security management, data backup)

blocks.zh: 欄二 Processes Requiring SOPs（需要 SOP 的流程）：列出該領域下每項需要書面程序的具體作業
blocks.en: Column 2, Processes Requiring SOPs: Lists each specific activity in that area that needs a written procedure

blocks.zh: 欄三 Typical Deliverable Documentation（典型交付文件）：作業執行後產生的品質記錄，供稽核追溯
blocks.en: Column 3, Typical Deliverable Documentation: The quality records generated once the activity is performed, which auditors use for traceability

blocks.zh: 這個三欄結構的精髓：光有「做了」還不夠，必須有文件證明「怎麼做」（SOP）和「做了什麼」（記錄）。
blocks.en: The essence of this structure: it is not enough to have "done it"; you need documents showing "how it is done" (the SOP) and "what was done" (the records).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：為何 IT 需要 SOP — 不只是驗證
blocks.en: Key Note: Why IT Needs SOPs, Not Just Validation

blocks.zh: 許多製藥公司誤以為 IT SOP 只在系統「驗證」期間有用。這是危險的誤解。IT 基礎設施 SOP 的功能包括：
blocks.en: Many pharmaceutical companies mistakenly believe IT SOPs are useful only during system "validation". This is a dangerous misunderstanding. IT infrastructure SOPs serve the following functions:

blocks.zh: 法規合規的持續性：FDA 21 CFR Part 11、EU Annex 11 要求電子記錄系統在整個生命週期均受管控，不只是上線時
blocks.en: Continuity of regulatory compliance: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 require electronic record systems to be controlled throughout their entire lifecycle, not just at go-live

blocks.zh: 人員流動的風險緩解：SOP 讓新進 IT 人員能按一致方式操作，不依賴個人記憶
blocks.en: Mitigation of staff turnover risk: SOPs let new IT staff work in a consistent way without relying on individual memory

blocks.zh: 偏差調查的依據：當系統異常或資料遺失時，SOP + 記錄是判斷責任歸屬的唯一客觀標準
blocks.en: Basis for deviation investigations: When a system fails or data is lost, the SOP plus records are the only objective standard for determining accountability

blocks.zh: 客戶稽核的信心建立：CDMO 的製藥客戶在審計時，通常會要求查看 IT SOP 清單及執行記錄
blocks.en: Building confidence in client audits: The pharmaceutical clients of a CDMO usually ask to see the list of IT SOPs and the execution records during audits

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：SOP 矩陣如同醫院的感染管控計畫
blocks.en: Analogy: The SOP Matrix Is Like a Hospital's Infection Control Program

blocks.zh: 醫院的感染管控計畫不只規範「手術室消毒」這一個動作。它涵蓋進出管控、人員訓練、設備維護、廢棄物處理、緊急應變——每一個環節都有對應的 SOP 和記錄要求。IT 基礎設施的 SOP 架構邏輯完全相同：從「誰可以進機房」到「備份失敗時如何處理偏差」，全部都需要正式化。
blocks.en: A hospital's infection control program does not regulate just one action such as "operating room disinfection". It covers access control, staff training, equipment maintenance, waste handling and emergency response, and every element has a corresponding SOP and record requirement. IT infrastructure SOPs follow exactly the same logic: from "who may enter the server room" to "how to handle a deviation when a backup fails", everything needs to be formalized.

blocks.zh: 安全管控 SOP：21 CFR Part 11 的直接連結
blocks.en: Security SOPs: The Direct Link to 21 CFR Part 11

blocks.zh: 矩陣中「Logical Security」（邏輯安全）部分要求的 SOP，直接對應 FDA 21 CFR Part 11 的條文要求：
blocks.en: The SOPs required in the "Logical Security" section of the matrix correspond directly to the provisions of FDA 21 CFR Part 11:

blocks.zh: User account management（使用者帳號管理）：對應 §11.10(d) — 限制系統存取僅限授權人員
blocks.en: User account management: Corresponds to §11.10(d), limiting system access to authorized individuals

blocks.zh: Password management（密碼管理）：對應 §11.300 — 確保電子簽名的唯一性與不可否認性
blocks.en: Password management: Corresponds to §11.300, ensuring the uniqueness and non-repudiation of electronic signatures

blocks.zh: Digital signature certificate management（數位簽章憑證管理）：對應 §11.100 — 電子簽名的身分認證要求
blocks.en: Digital signature certificate management: Corresponds to §11.100, the identity verification requirements for electronic signatures

blocks.zh: Logs of creation, deletion, transfers（帳號創建/刪除/職責移轉記錄）：對應 §11.10(e) — 完整的稽核軌跡
blocks.en: Logs of creation, deletion, transfers (account creation/deletion/transfer of responsibilities): Corresponds to §11.10(e), a complete audit trail

blocks.zh: 重點：唯一使用者帳號 + 稽核軌跡 = 21 CFR Part 11 合規的最基本要求。任何多人共用帳號或無法追溯的存取行為，都是立即的 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: Key point: unique user accounts plus an audit trail are the most basic requirements for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance. Any shared account used by several people, or any access that cannot be traced, is an immediate 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 資料管理 SOP：備份不等於驗證
blocks.en: Data Management SOPs: A Backup Is Not a Verified Backup

blocks.zh: 許多公司有執行備份，但忽略了矩陣要求「Restoration testing as part of disaster recovery testing」（還原測試）。這是 FDA 483 觀察的常見痛點：
blocks.en: Many companies run backups but overlook the matrix requirement for "Restoration testing as part of disaster recovery testing". This is a common pain point in FDA 483 observations:

blocks.zh: 備份計劃存在 ✓
blocks.en: Backup plan exists ✓

blocks.zh: 每日執行備份 ✓
blocks.en: Backups run daily ✓

blocks.zh: 備份媒體離站存放 ✓
blocks.en: Backup media stored off-site ✓

blocks.zh: 定期驗證備份可成功還原 ✗ ← 最常被忽略
blocks.en: Periodic verification that backups can be restored successfully ✗ ← most often overlooked

blocks.zh: 稽核員會問：「你上次成功執行 restore test 是什麼時候？有記錄嗎？」沒有還原測試紀錄等同於備份系統的有效性無法被證明。
blocks.en: The auditor will ask: "When did you last perform a successful restore test? Is there a record?" Without restoration test records, the effectiveness of the backup system cannot be demonstrated.

blocks.zh: CDMO 視角：FDA 483 高風險 SOP 類別排名
blocks.en: CDMO Perspective: Ranking of High-Risk SOP Categories for FDA 483

blocks.zh:
高風險（最常被引用）：
  1. Logical Security — 使用者帳號/密碼/稽核軌跡
  2. Data Backup & Restore — 缺少還原測試記錄
  3. Change Management — 未經變更管制的 IT 變更
  4. Training — IT 人員訓練記錄不完整

中風險（常見但可快速補救）：
  5. Configuration Management — 組態文件過時
  6. Quality Management — 未定期進行 IT 內部稽核
  7. Continuity Management — 災難復原計畫未定期測試

低風險（結構性問題，較少單獨被引用）：
  8. Job Scheduling — 批次作業偏差報告機制
  9. Networks — 第三方網路連接文件
blocks.en:
High risk (most frequently cited):
  1. Logical Security — user accounts/passwords/audit trails
  2. Data Backup & Restore — missing restoration test records
  3. Change Management — IT changes made without change control
  4. Training — incomplete IT staff training records

Medium risk (common but quickly remediated):
  5. Configuration Management — outdated configuration documents
  6. Quality Management — no regular IT internal audits
  7. Continuity Management — disaster recovery plan not tested regularly

Low risk (structural issues, rarely cited on their own):
  8. Job Scheduling — deviation reporting mechanism for batch jobs
  9. Networks — documentation of third-party network connections

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的 SOP 優先建置順序
blocks.en: Practical Application: Priority Order for Building CDMO SOPs

blocks.zh: 對於正在建立或重整 IT SOP 架構的 CDMO，建議依以下優先順序建置：
blocks.en: For a CDMO that is establishing or restructuring its IT SOP architecture, we recommend building in the following order of priority:

blocks.zh: 第一優先（法規直接要求）：Logical Security SOP 套件、Change Management SOP、Data Backup & Restore SOP（含還原測試）
blocks.en: First priority (directly required by regulation): Logical Security SOP package, Change Management SOP, Data Backup & Restore SOP (including restoration testing)

blocks.zh: 第二優先（稽核高頻查詢）：User Access Review 程序、Training Effectiveness Assessment、Configuration Management
blocks.en: Second priority (frequently asked about in audits): User Access Review procedure, Training Effectiveness Assessment, Configuration Management

blocks.zh: 第三優先（營運韌性）：Disaster Recovery Plan（含年度演練）、Capacity Management、Incident Management
blocks.en: Third priority (operational resilience): Disaster Recovery Plan (including annual drills), Capacity Management, Incident Management

blocks.zh: 不需要一次把所有 SOP 完美建立——先建立高風險的核心文件，其餘依照風險評估逐步補齊。
blocks.en: You do not need to build every SOP perfectly at once. Start with the high-risk core documents and fill in the rest step by step according to risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的公司目前是否有針對 IT 使用者帳號的「離職員工帳號停用」SOP？離職後帳號最晚在幾小時內必須停用？
blocks.en: Does your company have an SOP for deactivating the accounts of departed employees? What is the maximum number of hours after departure within which an account must be disabled?

blocks.zh: 上次你們的 IT 團隊執行備份還原測試（Restoration Testing）是什麼時候？測試結果有沒有正式記錄？
blocks.en: When did your IT team last perform a backup restoration test? Were the results formally recorded?

blocks.zh: 如果 FDA 稽核員要求查看過去 12 個月的 IT Change Control Records，你能在 30 分鐘內提交嗎？
blocks.en: If an FDA inspector asked to see the IT Change Control Records for the past 12 months, could you provide them within 30 minutes?

blocks.zh: 深度解析：關鍵 SOP 類別
blocks.en: In-Depth Analysis: Key SOP Categories

blocks.zh: Security SOP Requirements — 安全 SOP 詳解
blocks.en: Security SOP Requirements in Detail

blocks.zh: 「Emergency Access Management」的 GMP 意涵
blocks.en: GMP Implications of "Emergency Access Management"

blocks.zh: 矩陣特別點名「Management of emergency access」（緊急存取管理）需要 SOP，這是業界常見的合規漏洞。當系統緊急異常時，IT 人員可能使用共用的 emergency/root 帳號繞過正常的存取管制。
blocks.en: The matrix specifically calls out "Management of emergency access" as requiring an SOP, a common compliance gap in the industry. When a system fails urgently, IT staff may use a shared emergency/root account to bypass normal access controls.

blocks.zh: 合規要求：
blocks.en: Compliance requirements:

blocks.zh: 緊急存取帳號必須有 SOP 規範啟用條件、授權層級
blocks.en: Emergency access accounts must have an SOP defining activation conditions and authorization levels

blocks.zh: 每次使用必須記錄，事後補簽授權並進行審查
blocks.en: Every use must be recorded, with authorization signed retrospectively and the use reviewed

blocks.zh: 使用後必須重設密碼，防止憑證外洩
blocks.en: The password must be reset after use to prevent credential leakage

blocks.zh: 「緊急狀況」不能成為跳過管控的藉口——恰恰相反，緊急狀況時的紀律性更是法規關注的重點。
blocks.en: An "emergency" must not become an excuse for bypassing controls. On the contrary, discipline during emergencies is exactly what regulators focus on.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：備份如同保險，還原測試才是理賠演練
blocks.en: Analogy: A Backup Is Like Insurance, and Restoration Testing Is the Claims Drill

blocks.zh: 買了保險但從未確認保單內容是否有效——這就是「有備份但無還原測試」的情況。定期執行 Restoration Testing 等同於每年讓保險公司確認你的理賠條件仍然符合。沒有還原測試記錄，等於你的「保險」可能是一張空頭支票。
blocks.en: Buying insurance but never confirming that the policy is valid is the equivalent of "having backups but no restoration testing". Performing Restoration Testing regularly is like having the insurer confirm every year that your claim conditions are still met. Without restoration test records, your "insurance" may be a worthless promise.

blocks.zh: 「Authorization to Restore」的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of "Authorization to Restore"

blocks.zh: 矩陣要求 Restore 流程必須包含「authorization to restore」——這不只是技術操作，而是品質決策。在受 GxP 管控的環境中，從備份還原資料可能影響：
blocks.en: The matrix requires the restore process to include "authorization to restore". This is not just a technical operation but a quality decision. In a GxP-controlled environment, restoring data from backup can affect:

blocks.zh: 正在進行中的批次記錄完整性
blocks.en: The integrity of batch records currently in progress

blocks.zh: 電子批次記錄 (eBR) 的資料一致性
blocks.en: The data consistency of electronic batch records (eBR)

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡的連續性
blocks.en: The continuity of the audit trail

blocks.zh: 因此，「誰有權授權執行還原」必須在 SOP 中明確定義，不能由 IT 人員自行決定。
blocks.en: Therefore "who is authorized to approve a restore" must be clearly defined in the SOP and cannot be left to IT staff to decide on their own.

blocks.zh: Change Management SOP 的三個必要元素
blocks.en: Three Essential Elements of a Change Management SOP

blocks.zh: 矩陣要求 Change Management 包含：變更本身的 SOP + Risk Assessment + Management approval/rejection。這三者缺一不可：
blocks.en: The matrix requires Change Management to include the change SOP itself, a Risk Assessment, and Management approval/rejection. None of the three can be omitted:

blocks.zh: 變更 SOP：定義如何提出、評估、實施變更
blocks.en: Change SOP: Defines how changes are proposed, evaluated and implemented

blocks.zh: Risk Assessment（風險評估）：變更對 GxP 系統的潛在影響評估，決定是否需要再驗證
blocks.en: Risk Assessment: Evaluates the potential impact of the change on GxP systems and determines whether revalidation is needed

blocks.zh: Management approval/rejection（管理層核准）：確保變更決定有適當的組織授權，不能只由 IT 自行拍板
blocks.en: Management approval/rejection: Ensures the change decision has appropriate organizational authorization and is not made by IT alone

blocks.zh: 未經核准的 IT 變更（即使是「小」更新，如 patch 安裝）是 FDA 483 觀察中最常見的問題之一。
blocks.en: Unapproved IT changes (even "minor" ones such as patch installation) are among the most common problems in FDA 483 observations.

blocks.zh: 你的公司的 IT Change Management SOP 是否明確規定，哪些類型的變更需要 QA 審查？「緊急變更」的審批流程是什麼？
blocks.en: Does your company's IT Change Management SOP clearly specify which types of change require QA review? What is the approval process for "emergency changes"?

blocks.zh: 如果一名 IT 人員今天離職，你能在 24 小時內確認所有相關系統的帳號已被停用嗎？這個流程是否有 SOP 支持？
blocks.en: If an IT staff member left today, could you confirm within 24 hours that their accounts on all relevant systems had been deactivated? Is this process supported by an SOP?

blocks.zh: 品質管理與持續性管理 — Quality & Continuity Management SOPs
blocks.en: Quality & Continuity Management SOPs

blocks.zh: QA 與 IT 的交界：IT Quality and Compliance
blocks.en: Where QA and IT Meet: IT Quality and Compliance

blocks.zh: 「QA/IT Quality and Compliance」這個 SOP 類別要求 IT 部門本身有自我審計機制。這不只是 QA 部門的責任——IT 必須：
blocks.en: The "QA/IT Quality and Compliance" SOP category requires the IT department itself to have a self-audit mechanism. This is not solely the responsibility of the QA department; IT must:

blocks.zh: 維護自己的 Internal audit schedule（IT 自查排程）
blocks.en: Maintain its own Internal audit schedule (IT self-inspection schedule)

blocks.zh: 追蹤 corrective actions（矯正措施）的完成狀態
blocks.en: Track the completion status of corrective actions

blocks.zh: 定期監控 SLA performance（服務水準協議履行情況）
blocks.en: Periodically monitor SLA performance (fulfillment of service level agreements)

blocks.zh: 這意味著 IT 部門不能只是被動回應稽核發現——必須主動建立品質管理循環。
blocks.en: This means the IT department cannot merely respond passively to audit findings; it must proactively establish a quality management cycle.

blocks.zh: 災難復原計畫：不是一份文件，是一個演練程序
blocks.en: Disaster Recovery Plan: Not a Document but a Drill Procedure

blocks.zh: 矩陣要求的不只是 Disaster Recovery Plan（計畫文件），更要有 Disaster Recovery Test Reports（測試報告）。這強調 DRP 必須被定期演練並留有記錄。
blocks.en: The matrix requires not only a Disaster Recovery Plan (the plan document) but also Disaster Recovery Test Reports. This emphasizes that the DRP must be exercised regularly and the exercises recorded.

blocks.zh: FDA 稽核員的典型問題：
blocks.en: Typical questions from FDA inspectors:

blocks.zh: 「你們的 DRP 最後一次演練是什麼時候？」
blocks.en: "When was your DRP last exercised?"

blocks.zh: 「演練結果是否有識別出差距？差距如何補救？」
blocks.en: "Did the exercise identify gaps? How were the gaps remediated?"

blocks.zh: 「演練覆蓋了哪些關鍵 GxP 系統？」
blocks.en: "Which critical GxP systems did the exercise cover?"

blocks.zh: 一份從未被測試的 DRP，在稽核員眼中幾乎等同於沒有 DRP。
blocks.en: In an inspector's eyes, a DRP that has never been tested is almost the same as having no DRP at all.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：SLA 監控與 CDMO 客戶合約
blocks.en: Practical Application: SLA Monitoring and CDMO Client Contracts

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，SLA 監控 SOP 有特殊的商業意義。當 CDMO 承接大型製藥客戶的 IT 服務時（例如提供 eBR 系統存取、資料傳輸介面），客戶合約中通常包含系統可用性的 SLA 條款（例如 99.5% uptime）。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the SLA monitoring SOP has particular commercial significance. When a CDMO takes on IT services for a large pharmaceutical client (e.g. providing access to an eBR system or a data transfer interface), the client contract usually includes SLA terms on system availability (e.g. 99.5% uptime).

blocks.zh: SLA 監控 SOP 幫助 CDMO：
blocks.en: The SLA monitoring SOP helps the CDMO to:

blocks.zh: 客觀記錄系統可用性數據，保護自身免受不合理的違約索賠
blocks.en: Objectively record system availability data, protecting itself from unreasonable breach-of-contract claims

blocks.zh: 主動識別系統效能下滑趨勢，在客戶投訴前先行處理
blocks.en: Proactively identify declining performance trends and act before the client complains

blocks.zh: 在客戶品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 稽核時提供具體的履約證明
blocks.en: Provide concrete proof of performance during Quality Agreement audits by the client

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 是否有正式的 IT Internal Audit 程序？上次 IT 自查是什麼時候？發現的問題有沒有對應的 CAPA 記錄？
blocks.en: Does your CDMO have a formal IT Internal Audit procedure? When was the last IT self-inspection? Do the findings have corresponding CAPA records?

blocks.zh: 你們的 Disaster Recovery Plan 是否包含 GxP 關鍵系統（例如 LIMS、EBR、環境監控系統）的復原優先順序？復原目標時間 (RTO) 和復原點目標 (RPO) 分別是多少？
blocks.en: Does your Disaster Recovery Plan include the recovery priority of GxP-critical systems (e.g. LIMS, eBR, environmental monitoring system)? What are the Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO)?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: SOP 不只是驗證文件：IT 基礎設施 SOP 涵蓋整個系統生命週期——從安裝資格確認到停役封存，是持續合規的核心工具，而非一次性的驗證作業。
blocks.en: SOPs are more than validation documents: IT infrastructure SOPs cover the whole system lifecycle, from installation qualification to decommissioning and archiving, and are a core tool for continuous compliance rather than a one-time validation activity.

blocks.zh: 三欄矩陣邏輯：領域（Area）→ 需要 SOP 的流程（Processes）→ 交付文件（Deliverables）三者構成完整的「說到做到、做了留證」閉環。
blocks.en: Three-column matrix logic: Area → Processes requiring SOPs → Deliverables together form a complete closed loop of "say what you do, and keep evidence of what you did".

blocks.zh: Logical Security = 21 CFR Part 11 的實踐基礎：唯一帳號、密碼管理、緊急存取管制和完整稽核軌跡，是電子記錄合規性的最低標準，缺一不可。
blocks.en: Logical Security = the practical foundation of 21 CFR Part 11: Unique accounts, password management, emergency access control and a complete audit trail are the minimum standard for electronic record compliance, and none can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 備份驗證的關鍵差距：「有備份計畫」≠「備份有效」——Restoration Testing 是最常被忽略、也最常被稽核員查核的 IT SOP 要項。
blocks.en: The key gap in backup verification: "Having a backup plan" ≠ "the backups work". Restoration Testing is the IT SOP element most often overlooked and most often checked by auditors.

blocks.zh: CDMO 優先行動項目：Logical Security SOP、Change Management SOP、Data Backup & Restore SOP（含還原測試記錄）是 FDA 483 觀察中最高頻的三個類別，應優先建立並定期審查。
blocks.en: CDMO priority action items: The Logical Security SOP, Change Management SOP and Data Backup & Restore SOP (including restoration test records) are the three most frequent categories in FDA 483 observations and should be established first and reviewed regularly.
